items.summary: When admission resumes, prioritize existing affiliate repairs with explicit tracking-ID validation, link health checks, disclosure review, baseline metric, acceptance test, and rollback. Current revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the aggregate row is not site-attributable. Preserve all unknown revenue and attribution gaps.

Recommend approving no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, telemetry, deployments, dependencies, or requeues this cycle. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row is not site-attributable; site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and causal lift are unsupported. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27: 4,892 calls and $890.42 cost, approximately $0.182 per call as usage reporting only, not unit economics. Infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs are absent or incomplete; monthly budget limits are blank, so budget exposure is unbounded/unknown. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because no defined learning outcome, measurement window, or maximum learning cost exists. Treat clicks, impressions, sessions, rankings, conversions, orders, shipped items, AI calls, and pilot output as non-financial activity metrics. Continue only the existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation work; preserve explicit unknowns and reject unsupported revenue claims.
